description: Cartographie des points de communication impossible entre tronçons routiers is a dataset listed in Observatoire du Développement Durable de Corse open data portal, an open data portal (Opendatasoft) of a region, department, metropolitan area or agency, published or maintained by Direction Régionale de l'Environnement, de l'Aménagement et du Logement de Corse. Cartographie issue de la BD CARTO matérialisant une impossibilité ou une contrainte (restriction de poids et/ou de hauteur) de communication entre deux tronçons routiers. Coverage: Corsica. Its keywords are IGN, route, Bdcarto, données ouvertes, routier. The portal shows 11 records. It carries geographic features and can be exported as GeoJSON, KML or Shapefile. The portal shows 2003-09-16 as the last modification. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Licence Ouverte. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ods-oddc-datacorsica-portal.
